items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability, which is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92 as isolated patch files, addressing seven vulnerabilities including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension. A single crafted cookie can lead to remote code execution.}
